# Firearms Guardian

> Firearm legal expense and public liability cover for South African firearm owners, available through Acorn Brokers.

Firearms Guardian provides three monthly cover options: Essential at R135, Comprehensive at R245, and Premium at R325. Legal advice is available immediately after policy activation. A 1-month waiting period applies to legal representation and a 3-month waiting period applies to liability cover. Terms, conditions, exclusions, eligibility requirements, and final acceptance apply.

Acorn Brokers (Pty) Ltd is an authorised Financial Services Provider (FSP 47433). Firearms Guardian (Pty) Ltd is FSP 47115. The policy is underwritten by GENRIC Insurance Company Limited, FSP 43638, an authorised financial services provider and licensed non-life insurer.

Contact Acorn Brokers at info@acornbrokers.co.za or +27 (0)69 007 6320.
